nav.placeStart: Click on the map to set the start

note.notChecked: not checked: the way ends at the crossing node

sidewalk.yes: sidewalk=yes, to be mapped as separate

missingCrossing.missingWayProblem: No footway connected to the node
missingCrossing.missingTagProblem: Footway connected but without the footway=crossing tag
missingCrossing.wrongTagProblem: The way crossing the road at the crossing node has footway={{value}} instead of footway=crossing

crossingCandidate.problem: Connects a sidewalk on each side of a road but lacks the footway=crossing tag

reason.valueMismatch: Kerb tactile_paving differs from the crossing's
reason.incorrectNotMixed: incorrect expected: one kerb yes + one kerb no

island.levelProblem: Steps whose level=* does not overlap that of a directly connected way: the link is theoretically impassable
island.unjoinedProblem: Almost touches the main network but shares no node with it
island.isolatedProblem: Group of ways with no link to the main network

kerb.missingProblem: No barrier=kerb or kerb=no node found at this end
kerb.untaggedProblem: barrier=kerb or kerb=no node present but without a tactile_paving tag

completeness.title: Pedestrian network completeness
completeness.intro: Average of the five indicators below. The calculation is described in the {{link}}.

sidewalkSeparate.label: Sidewalks mapped separately
sidewalkSeparate.hint: all existing sidewalks mapped as separate (ideal form)

crossingsTagged.label: Fully tagged crossings
crossingsTagged.hint: footway=crossing present on the connected way

continuity.label: Sidewalk continuity
continuity.hint: roads with a sidewalk on both sides, among those with at least one

crossings.title: Pedestrian crossings
crossings.intro: Status of the highway=crossing nodes found on the analysable network.

meta.pedKm: {{now}} km of pedestrian ways now ({{first}} km at the first snapshot)

period.title: Analysis period
period.hint: The vertical scale of the charts adapts to the chosen period, which makes small variations visible. Default: the last 6 months.

compare.title: Since the last monthly snapshot
compare.hwTitle: Km by pedestrian infrastructure type: snapshot vs today
compare.hwSubtitle: Comparison between the last monthly snapshot ({{snapshot}}) and the most recent daily extract ({{today}}). Only dedicated pedestrian infrastructure is compared: roads (primary, etc.) change very little from one day to the next and are covered below.
compare.fwSubtitle: Detail of highway=footway ways by footway=* subtag, same two dates.

network.title: Network length (km)
network.allSubtitle: Pedestrian, road, cycleway. “Road” covers ways from residential to primary where pedestrians walk on the carriageway.
network.hwSubtitle: The six most common types by km.

quality.title: Pedestrian mapping quality
quality.swSubtitle: % of roads (residential → primary) with an explicit sidewalk tag (separate, yes, both, no), and the share still undocumented.
quality.xingSubtitle: A crossing is correctly mapped when it has both a highway=crossing node and a footway=crossing way. The gap between the two curves is the number of crossings left to complete.
quality.accSubtitle: % of footways with surface, % of footways with smoothness, % of crossings with tactile_paving.

footways.title: Footway composition
footways.mixSubtitle: sidewalk / crossing / link / traffic_island / other / no tag. “Other”: a footway=* subtag outside this list; “no tag”: no subtag.

sidewalks.title: Composition of sidewalk tags on roads
sidewalks.mixSubtitle: separate / yes / partial / no / no tag. When roads move from “yes” to “separate”, their sidewalks have been drawn as separate ways.
sidewalks.byTypeSubtitle: Same composition (separate / yes / partial / no / no tag), broken down by road type, for the latest point of the selected period.
sidewalks.noData: Detail by road type not yet available for {{date}}. It will appear after the next extraction.
sidewalks.noDataUndated: Detail by road type not yet available.
